mapper.select: SELECT device.id, device.tenant_id, device.organization_id, device.facility_id, device.device_type_id, device.thing_model_id, device.model_version, device.code, device.display_name, device.status, device.version, device.created_at, device.updated_at, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId}
SELECT path FROM organization WHERE id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
